kinds.box: No kind field: the retail package (箱絵), confidence high or medium. Show it as the box art.
kinds.dp: kind "dp": a gashapon DP card (台紙) shown on the machine. Capsule toys have no box; show it as the set image, not as a box.
kinds.maybe: kind "maybe": a low-confidence pick (about 4 in 5 were boxes when checked by eye; the rest are group photos, product shots or decal sheets). Never show it as box art; at most as an ordinary gallery image.

sources.name: BANDAI SPIRITS 商品情報 (bandaispirits.co.jp/products) — last slider image
sources.method: Last image of the product slider, accepted only when it is a white-padded box scan with a box-like aspect ratio (pixel check). Confidence high/medium/low from the share of flat background blocks; low picks are emitted as kind 'maybe' (not box art). Hotlinked from bandai-a.akamaihd.net; '/b/' 500px, swap to '/xl/' for 1200px.
sources.licence: © SOTSU・SUNRISE / BANDAI SPIRITS. Official product images, hotlinked only, not rehosted.

sources.name: BANDAI SPIRITS 商品情報 — first slider image
sources.method: Older pages (mostly MG and 1/100 old kits) put the box first; used when the last image is not a box and the first one passes the same pixel check. Confidence at most medium (low ones are kind 'maybe').

sources.name: Premium Bandai item images (bandai-a.akamaihd.net) — last image
sources.method: Plastic kits only (by name). Image count found by HEAD probes on the CDN (p-bandai.jp item pages are behind a JS challenge, not used); last image accepted after the pixel check with a stricter flat-background limit.
sources.licence: © SOTSU・SUNRISE / BANDAI SPIRITS / BANDAI NAMCO. Hotlinked only.

sources.name: Bandai Candy ガンダム食玩 (bandai.co.jp/candy/gundam) — specPkg image
sources.method:
The item's package block (

, usually pkg.png): the first one on the page, or, for a sub-item linked as page#id, the first one in that item's own section. NOW PRINTING placeholders (<= 25 KB) are skipped. Large PNG (~0.3–0.5 MB).

sources.name: Gashapon 【箱売】 products (Premium Bandai box sets) — box photo
sources.method: Box-sold capsule sets: image _1 (newer items) or _2 (older items) shows the shipping box front and back; accepted only when the pixel check finds a wide, solid pair of boxes.

sources.name: Gashapon capsule sets (gashapon.jp) — DP card
sources.method: Capsule toys have no box; image _1 of the set is the machine's DP card (台紙). Entries carry kind "dp".

sources.name: Gunplapedia (gunpla.fandom.com) infobox box art, joined by JAN
sources.method: Only used when static.wikia.nocookie.net serves images to non-browser clients (one HEAD probe per run); it answered with a Cloudflare challenge (403) when this was written, so no entries come from here.
sources.licence: Wiki text CC BY-SA 3.0; box art © SOTSU・SUNRISE / BANDAI SPIRITS. Hotlinked only.

not_covered.tamashii_figures: tamashiiweb.com product pages show figure photos only; no package shots are published (METAL BUILD, METAL ROBOT魂, ROBOT魂, S.H.Figuarts).
not_covered.web_manual: WEB取説 (manual.bandai-hobby.net) thumbnails live on bandai-hobby.net, which returns HTML instead of images to plain clients.
not_covered.bandai_hobby_site: bandai-hobby.net product images are CloudFront-signed URLs that expire within hours.
not_covered.mobile_suit_ensemble: MOBILE SUIT ENSEMBLE items link only per-figure gashapon.jp images; no set DP card URL in the catalog.
not_covered.premium_bandai_merch: Premium Bandai decals, cards, videos, books, games and apparel: no box image (their images are sheets, cards or product shots).
not_covered.premium_bandai_kits: 286 of 299 Premium Bandai plastic kits have no box image: their last CDN image is a product shot (item pages are behind a JS challenge, and their first images were never boxes in the checked samples).
